headline: Stefan Persson Family Increases Voting Rights Stake in H&M to 85.3%
summary: Stefan Persson's family acquired 3.5 million B-shares in H&M, lifting their ownership to 69.3% of equity and 85.3% of total voting power.
why: H&M is the world's second-largest fashion retailer; major shareholder share purchases tighten free float liquidity.

impacts.name: H&M
impacts.why: The controlling family bought 3.5 million B-shares, increasing voting control to 85.3%.
